candidates.name: Sarcoidosis
support_spans: Diffuse infiltration of the face with loss of skin creases and diminished facial hair
Multiple asymptomatic nodules on the upper arms for 40 days
enlarged axillary, cervical, and inguinal lymph nodes and enlarged spleen
candidates.why: The combination of skin and joint symptoms, along with lymph node and spleen enlargement, suggests a systemic disease like Sarcoidosis.

candidates.name: Lupus pernio
support_spans: Diffuse infiltration of the face with loss of skin creases and diminished facial hair
Multiple asymptomatic nodules on the upper arms for 40 days
candidates.why: The facial skin lesions and nodules on the arms are consistent with Lupus pernio, a form of cutaneous sarcoidosis.

candidates.name: Sarcoidosis
support_spans: Diffuse infiltrate of foamy histiocytes in the dermis
Numerous acid-fast bacilli present
candidates.why: The presence of foamy histiocytes and acid-fast bacilli suggests a granulomatous disease like Sarcoidosis, which is characterized by an abnormal immune response.

candidates.name: Rheumatoid arthritis
support_spans: Swelling and painful hand joints for 13 months
Rheumatoid factor: 70.1 IU/mL
contradict_spans: Normal results for: C-reactive protein, anticyclic citrullinated peptide, antinuclear antibodies
candidates.why: The joint symptoms and elevated rheumatoid factor suggest an autoimmune disease like Rheumatoid arthritis, although the normal results for other autoantibodies contradict this diagnosis.

candidates.name: Lepromatous leprosy
support_spans: Numerous acid-fast bacilli present
contradict_spans: No previous infections, family history, or personal medical history of autoimmune diseases or psoriasis
candidates.why: The presence of acid-fast bacilli suggests an infectious disease like Lepromatous leprosy, although the lack of previous infections or exposure history contradicts this diagnosis.
